description:
Split the existing 'Azure Interior - Whole Office Design' opportunity ($120,000) into two separate phased deals to match the client's billing cycle.

1. Rename the existing opportunity to 'Azure Interior - Design Phase', change the Expected Revenue to $20,000, and set the Expected Closing date to the end of the current month.
2. Create a NEW opportunity for the second phase named 'Azure Interior - Implementation Phase', set the Expected Revenue to $100,000, link it to the same customer (Azure Interior), and set the Expected Closing date to approximately 3 months from today.

Ensure both opportunities are saved and visible in the pipeline.
